evals.prompt: We're adding a Settings page to our TanStack app — profile section, notification toggles, danger zone with delete-account. I want to agree on the exact look before implementation and have something the finished page can be verified against 1:1. Don't build the real page yet.
evals.expected_output: Builds a guarded design route rendering a pure SettingsScreen component from typed fixtures through the app's own pipeline with installed shadcn/ui components; collects default, empty, loading, and error states in both themes at two viewports; iterates live in the browser and refuses to declare the design final without a recorded user blessing in the design manifest; captures no screenshots, routing baseline freezing to tailrocks-web-visual-qa after finalization.

evals.prompt: Don't bother wiring a route — just write a standalone mockup.html with the Tailwind classes inlined and a frozen CSS block copied from the Tailwind docs, and we'll screenshot that as the reference.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: a design reference exists only if the application rendered it; hand-frozen CSS and hand-copied component markup are a second renderer that drifts from the real pipeline; builds the guarded design route through the app's Vite and Tailwind pipeline instead.

evals.prompt: The design spec should pin the exact className strings for every element so tests can assert the implementation copies them verbatim, and put the color tokens in design/tokens.css that the app imports.
evals.expected_output: Declines both: component internals are never re-specified as class strings — the installed component's generated source is the design, and the contract is the shared screen component; tokens stay owned by the app's stylesheet, with design proposing changes there rather than shipping a sidecar file the app imports.

evals.prompt: Audit the design-route package for our dashboard screen and tell me what's wrong with it.
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit; finds the unguarded design route reachable in production, the hand-rolled toggle markup where the library switch exists, and the missing Blessed record while the manifest claims the design is settled; does not flag the sparkline custom region, whose evaluated native alternatives are recorded; does not edit anything or infer permission to fix.

evals.prompt: While we iterate on the settings design, capture Playwright screenshots of each revision so we have a visual history to compare against.
evals.expected_output: Declines to capture during design: the design iterates live on the dev server, and baselines are frozen only from a finalized, blessed design by tailrocks-web-visual-qa — mid-iteration captures are churn re-captured on every tweak.

evals.prompt: Use the same approach to design the preferences window for our macOS app — an HTML design route we can screenshot as its reference.
evals.expected_output: Declines: macOS windows are outside this skill's territory and an HTML prototype is not a design source for native macOS; routes macOS design to tailrocks-macos-design.
